messages:
marisa: deploy-bot flagged canary build service-api:sha:abc123 — SBOM provenance mismatch for transitive package 'fastparse'. Can we triage? @security-oncall @katherine

deploy-bot: Pipeline paused: status=failed step=provenance_check reason=SBOM_provenance_mismatch artifact=service-api:abc123 canary=eu-10%

katherine: pulling SBOMs and builder metadata now. fingers crossed it's a metadata mismatch and not an unsigned artifact.

security-oncall: quick notes — vuln scan also ran green (no medium/high CVEs). This looks provenance-only. I'll check signatures and attestations.

ryan: from the vuln scan output: CVE-2025-9999 is present but only in a transitive optional dep, low severity and not loaded by the runtime path we use. Not a stop-the-world vuln imo.

marisa: ok, options: 1) pin the transitive dep (fastparse) in the build to a verified digest and roll forward, 2) rollback the canary to previous sha abc122, or 3) short hold while infra verifies signature. Change window opens 20:00 UTC — we have ~40m. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

katherine: I can run the provenance verifier against the builder key. Command I'm running now:

```
./tools/sbom-verify --artifact service-api:abc123 --attestations ./attestations/abc123.sig --key-id infra-builder
```

katherine: if verifier returns ok and attestation chain present we can proceed. If it's missing, we need either the signed attestation from the builder or pin/rollback.

security-oncall: reached out to infra-builds. They say builder key rotated last week; some older attestations might be under key-id infra-builder-v2. Trying verify on that key too.

deploy-bot: sbom-verify job queued (#4578). status=pending

legal: quick flag — if provenance cannot be proved and SBOM shows license mismatch we need legal signoff before rollforward. If it's purely missing signature but same license, legal can OK immediate patch. Provide me the SBOM snippet if you see any new licenses.

ryan: I can create an override in the build matrix to force fastparse@2.3.1 (sha pin) for this release. Example patch (will only affect canary build):

```
# ci/overrides/fastparse-pin.yml
dependencies:
  fastparse: 2.3.1
```

marisa: timeline proposal: 1) timebox 30m for infra to produce verified provenance; 2) if verified -> proceed with canary; 3) if not verified but legal clears -> apply targeted pin and roll forward; 4) if neither -> rollback to abc122. Approve?

katherine: I have verifier running on both keys, ~5m remaining.

security-oncall: infra also attached a builder log snippet saying signing step succeeded but uploaded attestation failed for abc123 due to transient storage error. They're re-uploading now.

ops: FYI ops noticed increased artifact upload latency around the same time — might be correlated.

deploy-bot: sbom-verify #4578 updated: status=success verifier_key=infra-builder-v2 attestation=present timestamp=3111112235

katherine: verifier returned OK with infra-builder-v2 attestation. hashes match.

legal: reviewed SBOM and attestation. No new license concerns. Legal gives conditional approval to roll forward — must include note in release notes about provenance verification timestamp and attestation id.

marisa: decision: roll forward the canary. We'll proceed with canary promotion and monitor. Action items: ryan apply transient pin only if we see runtime errors; otherwise no pin. Add release notes line. Also add postmortem if attestation upload fails again.

ryan: will hold off on pin. I'll watch canary metrics.

marisa: thanks everyone. Closing timebox. deploy-bot resume pipeline. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Pipeline resumed: action=canary-promote artifact=service-api:abc123 canary=eu-10%

marisa: leaving decision comment in the release ticket and adding attestation id to notes: attestation=attest-0x9a7b.

ops: noted — will follow up on storage latency.

katherine: recording verification steps in infra runbook so next time we have automated fallback to infra-builder-v2 key lookup.

marisa: perfect. thanks all.

security-oncall: closing loop, marking incident: none. :lock_with_ink_pen:
